tile-companions.toScene: Go to scene on click (Tile Companions)

TILECOMPANIONS.HudTooltip: Tile Companions — bind a region, a sound, a light to this tile
TILECOMPANIONS.HudTooltipBound: Tile Companions — this tile has companions (add / re-trace / detach)

Warn.GMOnly: Only a Gamemaster can do this.
Warn.NoScene: This tile does not belong to a scene.
Warn.NoTile: Select a tile on the canvas first.
Warn.NoMacro: This region has no macro configured (or the macro was deleted).
Warn.NoTargetScene: This region has no scene configured (or the scene was deleted).
Warn.NoPlaylist: No playlist configured (or the playlist was deleted).
Warn.NoDocument: This region has no journal (or page) configured.
Warn.DocumentNoPermission: You do not have permission to read this document.
Warn.DocumentNoGM: No Gamemaster is online to give you access to this document — try again when one is.
Warn.DocumentGrantFailed: The Gamemaster could not give you access to this document.

Info.NothingToDo: Nothing to create: the tile already has those companions.
Info.BoundTraced: “{name}”: {list} bound to the tile — region shaped on the image's visible outline.
Info.BoundBox: “{name}”: {list} bound to the tile — region on the tile's box (image pixels not readable).
Info.Detached: “{name}”: companions detached (kept in the scene as independent documents).
Info.Retraced: “{name}”: region re-shaped on the image's visible outline.
Info.RetracedBox: “{name}”: region reset to the tile's box (image pixels not readable).
Info.JukeboxOffResumed: 🎷 Jukebox stopped — the Gamemaster's music resumes.
Info.ResyncDone: 🎷 Music re-synced for the whole table — the Gamemaster's playlist resumes.
Info.ResyncSilence: 🎷 Local music stopped for the whole table (no Gamemaster playlist playing).

Prompt.Title: Tile Companions
Prompt.Hint: Create companions that follow this tile when it is moved, resized, rotated, flipped, hidden or deleted.
Prompt.Multi: ({n} tiles selected: the same choices apply to each; names are taken from each tile.)
Prompt.Name: Name
Prompt.TraceHint: Region shaped on the image's non-transparent pixels. Unticked: the tile's rectangle.
Prompt.ClickHint: Makes the region clickable by players, without a token: run a macro, go to a scene, open a journal, or start a local jukebox. Everything else (hover label, colour…) is in the behavior's configuration.
Prompt.DocumentUuidHint: Overrides the journal above. Right-click a page title → Copy UUID.
Prompt.LightColorHint: Leave empty for a white light. Every other setting (animation, angle…) is in the light's own configuration, which opens after creation.
Prompt.UnbindConfirm: Delete the companions along with the link, or keep them in the scene as ordinary, independent documents?

label.label: Hover label
label.hint: Shown above the region on hover. Empty = the region name (or the target's name).

highlight.label: Highlight
highlight.hint: How the clickable area is signalled to players.

MacroBehavior.Hint: Makes the region clickable: a click runs the chosen macro on the clicking user's client — even without permission on the macro (no token needed). The macro runs with the player's rights: what they may not modify stays out of the script's reach.

macro.label: Macro to run
macro.hint: Drag and drop the macro (script or chat). It runs for the user who clicks, permission or not. In a script macro, scope.behavior and scope.region give the context.

SceneBehavior.Hint: Makes the region clickable: a click takes the clicking user to the chosen scene (no token needed — a door, a staircase, a city map…). Players reach it even when it is not in the navigation bar.

activateForAll.label: Activate for the whole table (GM)
activateForAll.hint: When the Gamemaster clicks: activate the scene for every player instead of viewing it alone. No effect for a player.

DocumentBehavior.Hint: Makes the region clickable: a click opens a journal (or a specific page) for the clicking user — a poster, a letter, a newspaper, a clue… If the player may not see it, the online Gamemaster automatically grants them Observer permission (permanent, per player).

document.label: Journal or page
document.hint: Drag and drop a journal, or a journal page (UUID JournalEntry.x.JournalEntryPage.y).

grant.label: Grant the clicker permission
grant.hint: Gives Observer to the player who clicks (through the online Gamemaster — one must be online). Unticked: only players who already have permission can open it.

JukeboxBehavior.Hint: Makes the region clickable: a click starts (or stops) a local jukebox on the chosen playlist for the clicking user. It fades out their music (Music channel only — not environment nor interface) and plays on the Interface channel, adjustable with their Interface slider. No GM needed; the GM can see who listens to what and stop everything.

playlist.label: Playlist
playlist.hint: Drag and drop the playlist. Its mode (sequential, shuffle, simultaneous) and per-track loops are honoured.

mode.label: Playback mode
mode.hint: Overrides the playlist's mode for this region.

CascadeDelete.Name: Delete companions with the tile
CascadeDelete.Hint: When a bound tile is deleted, its region, sound and light are deleted too. Off: they stay in the scene, unlinked.

AutoRetrace.Name: Re-trace the region when the image changes
AutoRetrace.Hint: When a bound tile gets a new image, its region is re-shaped on the new image's visible outline.

SyncHidden.Name: Hide companions with the tile
SyncHidden.Hint: Hiding / showing a bound tile hides / shows its region, sound and light.
